instruction: Locate the highest Sales value in column B and shade its cell with any fill color.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum Sales value in column B and highlighting it with fill color. Evaluator verifies TWO conditions: (1) identifies which cell contains the maximum Sales value by scanning all values in column B, and (2) checks that the cell with the maximum value has fill color applied. This ensures both steps of the instruction are correctly completed.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: The evaluator correctly verifies BOTH requirements: (1) the getter scans all values in column B to identify the cell with maximum Sales value dynamically (not hard-coded), and (2) it checks that the highlighted cell matches the max cell and has fill color applied.

Correct semantic verification: The getter extracts 'is_max_cell' by comparing 'highlighted_cell == max_cell_address', ensuring the highlighted cell actually contains the maximum value. The metric checks both 'has_fill' AND 'is_max_cell', so it will correctly reject cases where the wrong cell is highlighted.

Robust logic: The getter handles edge cases (empty cells, non-numeric values), scans the entire column dynamically, and the metric correctly implements AND logic for both conditions. The postconfig saves the file to ensure fresh state.
